obligations.subject: n1

obligations.subject: e10
obligations.response: shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which approved the vehicle type
obligations.ears: When an existing vehicle type is modified, every modification shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which approved the vehicle type.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.ears: When a modification is notified, the Type Approval Authority shall then either decide that a new type-approval is to be granted or apply the modification procedure.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: the modification shall be designated a "revision"
obligations.ears: When particulars recorded in the information folder have changed and the Type Approval Authority considers that the modifications made are unlikely to have an appreciable adverse effect and that in any case the vehicle still complies with the requirements, the modification shall be designated a "revision".

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall issue the revised pages of the information folder as necessary, marking each revised page to show clearly the nature of the modification and the date of re-issue
obligations.ears: When a modification is designated a revision, the Type Approval Authority shall issue the revised pages of the information folder as necessary, marking each revised page to show clearly the nature of the modification and the date of re-issue.

obligations.subject: n6
obligations.response: shall be deemed to meet this requirement
obligations.ears: A consolidated updated version of the information folder, accompanied by a detailed description of the modification, shall be deemed to meet this requirement.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: The modification shall be designated an "extension"
obligations.ears: When, in addition to the change of the particulars recorded in the information folder, further conditions apply, the modification shall be designated an "extension".

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be communicated by the procedure specified in paragraph 4.3. above to the Parties to the Agreement which apply this Regulation
obligations.ears: Confirmation or refusal of approval, specifying the alterations shall be communicated by the procedure specified in paragraph 4.3. above to the Parties to the Agreement which apply this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: the index to the information package, attached to the communication document, shall be amended accordingly to show the date of the most recent revision or extension
obligations.ears: The index to the information package, attached to the communication document, shall be amended accordingly to show the date of the most recent revision or extension.

obligations.subject: e10
obligations.response: shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 5. and 6. above
obligations.ears: The vehicle (separate technical unit) approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 5. and 6. above.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.ears: The holder of the approval shall in particular fulfil the following obligations.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: Ensure that data of test results are recorded and that related documents shall remain available for a period to be determined in accordance with the Type Approval Authority
obligations.ears: The holder of the approval shall ensure that data of test results are recorded and that related documents shall remain available for a period to be determined in accordance with the Type Approval Authority.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: Ensure that any sampling of samples or test pieces giving evidence of non-conformity with the type of test considered shall give rise to another sampling and another test
obligations.ears: When any sampling of samples or test pieces gives evidence of non-conformity with the type of test considered, the holder of the approval shall ensure that it gives rise to another sampling and another test.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: All the necessary steps shall be taken to re-establish the conformity of the corresponding production
obligations.ears: When evidence of non-conformity is found, the holder of the approval shall take all the necessary steps to re-establish the conformity of the corresponding production.
